name: Remove carried item
description: Takes away what Mario carries. 'Delete it' finds the sprite with status $0B (carried) in the status table !14C8 ($14C8 without SA-1), deletes it and clears Mario's carrying flags $1470 and $148F. 'Let go of it' releases the run button ($15 bit 6) and left / right for a frame, so Mario drops it. To use a key on a lock, check for the key with Mario holds sprite first.
author: BlockCreator
